review.note: Selected on which distribution the advisory is against, not on how many there are. An advisory against flask, werkzeug, pyjwt, cryptography, jinja2, django, pillow or urllib3 is against something the repository calls, so upgrading it can break calling code — which is the entire subject of this project. An advisory against black, pytest, pip, virtualenv, wheel or filelock is against build tooling and can break nothing. apiflask advertised three advisories and every one was the second kind.
